requirements.text: Customers should be able to book appointments online, choosing their service, barber, and a convenient time.
Immediate booking confirmations should be sent to customers.
Reminders via text or email should be sent a day before and an hour before the appointment.
Customers should have the ability to cancel or change appointments online.
Implement a 24-hour notice period for cancellations.
Barbers should be able to set their own hours and update their availability.
The system must prevent double bookings.
